props.name: size
props.description: `lg` (default): the control height, for a field on its own in a form or a dialog. `md`: a field in a toolbar or a filter row, as high as the row's `md` buttons and filter triggers (32px by touch, with a 44px tap area; the control height with a mouse).

props.name: suppressPasswordManager
props.description: Add common password-manager ignore hints for non-credential fields where extension overlays would obscure custom UI.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input. Use when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the `value` changes. Use when controlled.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the input. Use when controlled.
